metadata.description: Agent skills organised by domain — deeply researched, provenance-tracked, and kept current against fast-moving ecosystems

plugins.name: generative-media-skills
plugins.description: Authoritative ComfyUI, diffusers, and API guides for generative media models — image (FLUX.2, Ideogram 4, Z-Image, SDXL, Krea 2, Anima) and video (Wan 2.2, MiniMax H3, LTX-2.5, SCAIL-2) — spanning setup, prompting across tag and natural-language conditioning classes, ControlNet and motion/camera control, native audio-video generation, multishot single-generation cuts, face identity, character consistency across frames and shots, in-video character replacement, LoRA training and evaluation, the image-to-video handoff, licence and territory pitfalls, multi-stage and mixed-model production pipelines, GPU deployment on RunPod, and failure modes
